CustomWidgets.AllowedDomainsDescription: Iframes, images, videos and audio loaded from other domains are blocked by the browser (Content Security Policy). List the domains you trust, for example www.youtube.com, *.example.com or https://cdn.example.com.
CustomWidgets.AllowedDomainsSaved: The allowed domains have been saved.
CustomWidgets.DeleteWidgetConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the widget %s? It will not be displayed on the dashboards anymore.
CustomWidgets.InvalidDomain: "%1$s" is not a valid domain. Use a host name such as www.example.com, *.example.com or https://cdn.example.com.
CustomWidgets.ManageIntro: Create widgets with your own content (text, HTML, videos, iframes...), then add them to your dashboards from the "Custom Widget" category of the Dashboard menu.
CustomWidgets.NoWebsiteSelected: No website selected: the widget will be displayed on all websites.
CustomWidgets.NoWidgets: No widget yet. Create a widget to display your own content on the dashboards.
CustomWidgets.PreviewScriptsNotice: Scripts are not executed in the preview, they only run on the dashboards.
CustomWidgets.WidgetContentHelp: Text and HTML. Content loaded from other domains is only displayed if the domain is listed in the allowed external domains.
CustomWidgets.WidgetNotAvailable: This widget is not available for this website anymore.
CustomWidgets.WidgetTitleHelp: Name of the widget in the Dashboard menu and in the header of the widget.
CustomWidgets.WidgetTitleTooLong: The widget title cannot be longer than %s characters.
